chunks: 4 - My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Sa'd b. 'Abdullah narrated to us. He said: al-Haytham b. Abi Masruq al-Nahdi narrated to us from al-Husayn b. 'Ilwan from 'Amr b. Thabit. He said: Muhammad b. Humran narrated to me from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad (peace be upon them). He said:
Whoever glorifies Allah thirty times per day, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, will repel seventy forms of calamity from him, the smallest of which is poverty.

key_terms.تَسْبِيح: Tasbih: glorification of Allah, saying 'Subhan Allah' (Glory be to Allah)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for glorifying Allah thirty times daily according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted from Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS), teaches the immense spiritual benefit of daily tasbih (glorification of Allah). Saying 'Subhan Allah' thirty times each day repels seventy types of calamity, the least of which is poverty. This was taught in the 13th Assembly of al-Amali during Ramadan 367 AH, emphasizing that even a small daily practice of dhikr brings enormous divine protection.

en.bilal-muhammad: My father (rh) narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. `Abdullah narrated to us. He said: Al-Haytham b. Abi Masruq al-Nahdi narrated to us from al-Husayn b. `Ilwan from `Amr b. Thabit. He said: Muhammad b. Humran narrated to me from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as). He said:
Whoever glorifies Allah (tasbih) Allah thirty times per day, Allah will repel seventy forms of calamity from him, the smallest of which is poverty.
